privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Policy
privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. Below we inform you about the collection, processing, and use of your data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

1.title: 1. Name and Contact Details of the Controller
1.content: This privacy information applies to data processing by:

2.title: 2. Collection and Storage of Personal Data

a.title: a) When visiting the website
a.content: When calling up our website, information is automatically sent to the server by the browser. This is temporarily stored in log files:

b.title: b) When using our contact form
b.content: When using the contact form, we collect: Name, email address, phone number (optional), your message.

c.title: c) When using the website analyzer
c.content: When using the website analyzer, we collect: The analyzed URL, email address (for report delivery), analysis results are temporarily stored.

d.title: d) When using the chatbot (Jarvis)
d.content: The chatbot stores your conversation locally in the browser to provide chat functionality. The messages are transmitted to external AI services for processing (see section 4).

3.title: 3. Cookies
3.content: We use the following cookie categories:

necessary.title: Necessary Cookies
necessary.desc: Required for basic website functions (session, cookie settings).

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.desc: Save your preferences like chatbot history (localStorage).

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies (optional)
analytics.desc: Google Analytics to improve our website - only with your consent.

3.note: You can adjust your cookie settings at any time via the cookie banner.

4.title: 4. AI Services and Automated Processing
4.note: Note: Our AI assistant 'Jarvis' and the website analyzer use external AI services for processing.

gemini.title: a) Google Gemini API
gemini.content: For the chatbot and website analyzer, your requests are transmitted to the Google Gemini API. Processed are: Your chat messages, website content during analysis. Legal basis: Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. a GDPR (Consent via use).

perplexity.title: b) Perplexity API
perplexity.content: The Perplexity API is used for advanced search queries. Only the search queries are transmitted, no personal data.

disclaimer.title: c) No Legal/Medical Advice
disclaimer.content: AI-generated answers are for informational purposes only and do not replace professional advice. We assume no liability for decisions made based on AI answers.

art15.desc: Information about your personal data processed by us.

art16.desc: Correction of incorrect or completion of your data.

art18.title: Art. 18

art20.title: Art. 20
art20.desc: Data portability in a common format.

art21.title: Art. 21
art21.desc: Objection to the processing of your data.

7.content: We use TLS/SSL encryption for all data transmissions. Our systems are regularly updated and checked for security vulnerabilities. Access to personal data is restricted to authorized employees.
